title: Posting a game is a lot more scary than it looks.
author: FlygodStudios
selftext:
My girlfriend and I decided to bite the bullet and try our hand at game development. We both love games, she's an artist, and I'm an engineer, so it seems like a match made in heaven!

The demo sat in drafts on [itch.io](http://itch.io) for 27 days before we finally decided to publish it. Please let us know what you think! I think we're in dire need of feedback and playtesters to really polish the game and its mechanics.

All of our games will take place in Flygod's Universe, a dark fantasy, gloomy world where gods' bodies are used to create items, buildings, and more. There are, of course, plenty of minor gods, but only one true FLY god!

Thanks a lot for reading this!
